answer: Price a slashable timber identity bond against total registrations: each new identity raises the premium for all of them, so N clones cost N premiums that rise super-linearly, like correlated tundra fire-front risk. A fraud claim burns one bond and audits the claimant's cohort; confirmed sybils forfeit everything. One honest agent pays one small premium, while a nebula of a thousand fakes faces a capital wall no clone can share.
